{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# 1. Fix revenue: remove commas and convert to float
data['revenue'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# 2. Remove QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
qa_mask = data['revenue'] == 999999.99
data = data[~qa_mask]

# 3. Remove refunded orders (status == 'refunded')
refunded_mask = data['status'] == 'refunded'
data = data[~refunded_mask]

# 4. Compute conversion rate within each segment
seg_conv = data.groupby(['customer_segment', 'channel'])['converted'].mean().reset_index()

# 5. Compute difference in conversion rates within each segment: email - paid_search
email_conv = seg_conv[seg_conv['channel'] == 'email'].set_index('customer_segment')['converted']
paid_search_conv = seg_conv[seg_conv['channel'] == 'paid_search'].set_index('customer_segment')['converted']
seg_diff = email_conv - paid_search_conv

# 6. Compute segment size proportions
segment_sizes = data['customer_segment'].value_counts(normalize=True)

# 7. Compute weighted average difference
weighted_diff = (seg_diff * segment_sizes).sum()
weighted_diff_pct = weighted_diff * 100

# 8. Print all required numbers explicitly
print("Segment-level conversion rates (email):")
print(email_conv)
print("\nSegment-level conversion rates (paid_search):")
print(paid_search_conv)
print("\nSegment-wise differences (email - paid_search):")
print(seg_diff)
print("\nSegment size proportions:")
print(segment_sizes)
print("\nWeighted average difference (email - paid_search):")
print(weighted_diff_pct)

# Return the final value
weighted_diff_pct"}
